title: AlphaGo Co-Creator Launches Metis Reasoning to End AI Hallucinations
summary:
A new artificial intelligence lab based in London is seeking venture capital to build a system that verifies its own reasoning process through evidence and assumption testing. Thore Graepel, a former Google DeepMind research lead and AlphaGo co-creator, announced the launch of Metis Reasoning on Oct. 20 to eliminate hallucinations and agentic overreach. The company is located in the Kings Cross AI cluster and is developing an approach that moves away from generating plausible answers toward a verifiable, evidence-based process.

Graepel and a team of mathematicians and robotics experts released a white paper titled "The Age of Reasoning" to detail the research foundations of the startup. He is discussing these theories today at NVIDIA GTC in Berlin. The approach is inspired by the principles of AlphaGo, focusing on general and embodied AI that can establish what it knows and learn from experience.

I am delighted to announce the launch of Metis Reasoning, a new AI company I have founded with a team of researchers, mathematicians, robotics experts and entrepreneurs.

We are pursuing a different approach to general and embodied AI reasoning: developing systems that can establish what they know, test conclusions against evidence and learn to reason more effectively through experience.

Alongside today's launch, we are publishing The Age of Reasoning, a white paper setting out the research foundations of our approach and what we believe the next generation of AI could look like.

I will also be discussing these ideas @NVIDIAGTC in Berlin today, alongside researchers exploring new approaches to AI.

selectedTweets.text:
ANOTHER UK AI lab has just emerged from stealth. 

This one is founded by AlphaGo co-creator and former Google DeepMind research lead Thore Graepel (@ThoreG)

Metis Reasoning is tackling one of the largest problems that exists in AI. 

Currently, AI can give you a convincing answer but it is impossible to understand how the AI got to that answer, and whether the steps it took to get there were justified.

Inspired by the principles behind AlphaGo, Metis's answer is to rethink how AI reasons. 

Rather than relying on models to generate plausible answers, the company is developing an approach in which systems establish conclusions through gathering evidence, testing assumptions and verifying their progress.

Thore has been public about building something in this space, but the company itself has been in stealth until now. 

The founding team have also released a white paper labelled "The Age of Reasoning" which sets out the full thesis.

NICE
